chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: Brothers Dave and Bob; Schillinger method
summary: After the Club Kentucky closed, McRae played with brother Dave in White Plains; Bob studied at Juilliard, prompting talk of the Schillinger system.
